A blocked nose, facial pressure, headache and difficulty breathing comfortably can make everyday life difficult. Sinusitis occurs when the lining of the sinuses becomes inflamed, causing swelling and interfering with normal mucus drainage. Colds, allergies, dust and pollution can all contribute to nasal congestion.
In this video, Hansaji explains natural ways to manage sinus discomfort through simple home remedies, suitable yogic practices, nutrition and a healthier home environment.
You will learn about:
1. Using warm compresses and gentle humidification to soothe sinus pressure.
